 Time to finally cop the things that have been sitting in your wishlist for ages.
 Photos: Courtesy of Amazon.com and Amazon US, Germany and Japan By  Nicole Ng  -  published 19 Nov 2026 
 Black Friday season is upon us! It’s one of the best opportunities to shop in terms of bigger-than-usual discounts and timing. And with it being T-minus one month to Christmas, it’s high time to load up your carts. Amazon is spoiling us with deals again from 19 to 30 November, with up to 35 percent off Bioderma skincare and 20 percent off KitchenAid , for example.
 Below, the best Black Friday deals the BAZAAR team has been eyeing on Amazon.

 Best Amazon Black Friday Sale Picks
 Bioderma Sensibio H2O Micellar Water (Duo Pack) 
 $30 $44 (32% off) 
 Photo: Courtesy of Amazon US “I always keep a small bottle of the Bioderma Sensibio H2O Micellar Water with me on flights to refresh my skin quickly. I am wary of using water from the aircraft sink on my face and this no-rinse formula is great for removing makeup, or just general skin cleansing. Just saturate a cotton pad with it, and swipe the grime and dirt off.” — Arissa Ha, Senior Beauty Editor 
 Shop Now Kodak Ultra F9 Film Camera 
 $74 
 Photo: Courtesy of Amazon Germany “If there’s a go-to item that I’d buy for myself or as a gift, it’ll always be a film camera. There’s a certain charm in tactile hardware, the careful thought put into everything, the click of the shutter and the unpredictability of the images that I love.” — Gracia Phang, Style Editor 
 Shop now Marvis Classic Strong Mint Toothpaste 
 $13 $17 (25% off) 
 Photo: Courtesy of Amazon US “Beautiful packaging hates to see me coming. Marvis ’ vintage-style tube caught my eye when I first saw it overseas years ago, and I’ve seen so many reviews that rave about the clean taste and how long each tube lasts you, so I’m excited to finally try it out.” — Nicole Ng, Content Producer

 Ninja Creami Scoop&Swirl Ice Cream Maker (Amazon Exclusive) 
 $361 $452 (20% off) 
 Photo: Courtesy of Amazon.com “If you know me, you would know I love a good sweet treat after dinner. I usually settle for a McDonald’s soft serve run but how exciting would it be to have a machine in your home? I’m a huge DIY gal but I always thought homemade soft serve was unrealistic until now!” — Larissa Wong, Content Producer 
 Shop now Jall Sunrise Alarm Clock 
 $68 
 Photo: Courtesy of Amazon Germany “My phone is getting a little old and its alarm app has gotten a little glitchy over the past year, so I’ve been thinking of getting an alarm clock as a fail-safe. This not only acts as a clock with multiple timer settings (so you can have different ones for weekends and weekdays), it also has a lighting function that slowly brightens your room to mimic a sunrise before the alarm sets in, so no jumpscares here.” — Nicole Ng, Content Producer

 Lego Idea Home Alone 
 $361 $470 (23% off) 
 Photo: Courtesy of Amazon Japan “ Home Alone is a requisite viewing experience each Christmas in my household, so I can only imagine doubling the joy by watching the movie and building said house with Legos . The details are kinda incredible and it makes a great gift—whether it is for yourself or for someone else.” — Aaron Kok, Fashion Editor 
 Shop now Amazon Kindle Coloursoft 
 $317 $423 (25% off) 
 Photo: Courtesy of Amazon US “I’ve always loved the feeling of holding a physical book, but the Kindle Coloursoft makes digital reading incredibly appealing. What I love most is its seven-inch colour display, which brings book covers, illustrations and graphic novels to life while maintaining the comfortable, paper-like reading experience Kindle is known for. With enough storage for thousands of books and a battery that can last for weeks, it’s perfect for someone like me who enjoys having an entire library at my fingertips, wherever I go.” — Brandon Chia, Jewels & Watches Editor
